text:
ada: Noticed surge of reconnects in ap-northeast at ~03:20 UTC after proxy tweak to return 204 on idle probes. Mobile clients emit immediate reconnects.

bryan: Is this SSE or WS?

ada: Mostly WS upgrades. Proxy probe returned HTTP/1.1 204 during in-flight upgrade and client lib treated it as non-upgrade close.

mina: Can we short-circuit: proxy should translate probe 204 -> 200 with a noop frame so client libs don't close.

infra-bot: Alert: stream-probe-204-spike-apne-03:20. Paging oncall.

bryan: Also seeing billing bumps: each reopen counts as a new session. We need quota-side dedupe for quick reconnects (window ~5-7s).

ada: Proposed immediate plan: (1) deploy proxy mapping in ap-northeast canary, (2) add quota dedupe by token+client_id in 7s window, (3) patch SDKs to treat 204 as probe when header X-Stream-Compat=1 is present.

mina: Long-term: add routing policy flag `keepalive_mode` with values legacy/compat/strict and surface in Console. That prevents silent semantic changes in rollouts.

console-bot: Temporary console mute for stream-close alerts on /v1/ws/*:ap-northeast for 2h.

oncall-bot: Runbook linked.

bryan: I'll own canary and dashboards. Capture metrics: proxy.probe.204_rate, stream.conn.reopen_rate, billing.session.delta. Rollback if reopen_rate > 4x baseline.

ada: I'll open PR for proxy and quota changes. Tagging @bryan @mina. ETA for first canary: 06:00 UTC.

mina: Good. Also add rollout annotation in Console noting keepalive semantics change for the route so ops know why reconnects might happen.
